scientific_scene.scope: Vela-informed calculated 0.1–100 GeV outgoing photon visualization; not a quantitative Vela reconstruction
scientific_scene.reused_physics: Same force-free snapshot, cached trajectories, prescribed acceleration and signed curvature transport with original 3-node spectral integration
scientific_scene.sampling: Deterministic equal-photon-number systematic quadrature, ordered by 64 polar-direction and 240 arrival-phase strata; each packet retains an actual source-cell midpoint and exact lab direction; no angular convolution
scientific_scene.packet_spectra: Original four-band photon fractions attached to each selected cell; additive photon-number weights
scientific_scene.phase_convention: Phi=(t_em-azimuth(n)-n.r)/(2pi) modulo 1; distant angular observer, original 2deg polar pixel
scientific_scene.packet_geometry: Source midpoint quadrature; no interpolation into artificial cones; directions fixed after emission

propagation: x(T)=Rz(te)r0+(T-te)Rz(te)n0; c=1; no rotation of emitted photons
display_weight: Each packet equal integrated 0.1–100GeV photon number; band fractions color mixed in linear light
velocity_annotations: 160 sparse sampled packet velocity arrows; calculated positions/directions, display-only length 0.24RLC, not field lines or extra emissivity
color: Explicit false color: increasing gamma-ray energy from blue through cyan and cream to orange; not visible light
exposure_selection: 2 times 99.5 percentile nonzero pixel peaks over 12 phases, fixed
receiver: Fixed bearing glyph; true far-observer time convention, original finite 2deg polar bin; pulse trace is full original profile, not finite dot counts
star_marker: 2.1-reference-pixel position marker; not a resolved stellar surface

export.rate_control: quality-targeted VBR with a VBV cap; CRF is not a platform requirement
export.color_conversion: sRGB RGB to Rec.709 limited-range YCbCr via zscale; pixels transformed before tagging
export.conversion_reference: display-referred: sRGB EOTF to linear light, then inverse BT.1886 (gamma 2.4) for Rec.709 display encoding
export.instagram_processing: Instagram generates its own delivery encodings; playback quality is not guaranteed by local export
